allowedSourceMaterial.overview: The wife of an American doctor suddenly vanishes in Paris. To find her, he navigates a puzzling web of language, locale, laissez-faire cops, triplicate-form filling bureaucrats and a defiant, mysterious waif who knows more than she tells.

facts.title: Frantic

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: Spousal disappearance could argue heavy, but procedural mystery handling supports moderate.
Familiar thriller grammar and different Paris-language displacement are both grounded.
Thriller momentum may suggest exciting, yet packet cues emphasize uncertainty and withheld information.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: A defiant, streetwise young woman seems to hold crucial clues about the disappearance, but she is telling only part of what she knows.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: When an American doctor's wife suddenly vanishes from their Paris hotel room, he is thrust into an unfamiliar city, battling language barriers, indifferent police, and bureaucratic delays to find her.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful mystery of foreign displacement, demanding engaged focus without crushing emotional weight.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Roman Polanski directs a taut neo-noir mystery where an ordinary man faces foreign isolation and tightening suspense across an unhelpful Paris.
